note: Edit this file to refresh the Attack advisor after a balance update. ids are the game's ids (see the Levels tab). troops/spells are [id,count] at 340 camp space and 11 spell space; the app scales them to each account. flex = the troop that absorbs bigger or smaller camps; xspell = the spell that absorbs extra spell space.

strategies.name: RC Walk Root Riders
strategies.army: Root Riders as the main push, with Valkyries (or Druids) behind them, a Siege Barracks or Battle Drill, and a Root Rider in the Clan Castle.
strategies.spells: 2–3 Invisibility for the Royal Champion, Rage + Freeze for the main push, an Earthquake if walls are thick.
plan: Send the Royal Champion in on one corner and use Invisibility to carry her through key defenses. That sets one side of the funnel.
Use the Queen (or Dragon Duke) to clear the other side so the funnel is wide.
Drop Root Riders in a line through the middle of the funnel, Valkyries right behind them.
Rage when they reach the core, Freeze the Infernos or Monolith as the push arrives.
Keep the Warden with the main group and pop his ability when the core fights start.

shape.compact: Root Riders smash walls and walk straight, so tight compartments don't slow them
shape.boxed: many wall layers are exactly what Root Riders break through

core.weak: a weak core means the Root Riders finish the job once they're in

air.tight: the air defense is strong, so a ground push avoids it

inferno.multi: Multi Infernos do little to a few high-hitpoint Root Riders

scout.new: it's forgiving on a base you haven't seen before

strategies.name: Fireball Super Yeti
strategies.army: Super Yetis as tanks with Witches behind them, 2 Ice Golems, a Super Wall Breaker and a Super Yeti in the Clan Castle.
strategies.spells: Earthquake, Rage, Freeze and Poison, plus whatever space remains for Rage or Freeze.
plan: Use the Warden's Fireball to delete 2–3 key defenses: the Eagle/Inferno Artillery and an Inferno are the usual picks.
Make a funnel with the Queen or Royal Champion on one side.
Drop Super Yetis in a line with the Ice Golems in front to soak the first big hits.
Witches go behind the Yetis. The Yetimites they create distract single-target defenses.
Warden walks with the main group. Rage the core and Freeze Monolith/Infernos as you arrive.

core.strong: Fireball deletes the core defenses before the push arrives

eagle.core: the Eagle/Inferno Artillery sits where Fireball can reach it

scout.new: it's the safest triple on an unknown base

shape.compact: Yetimites flood compact compartments and overwhelm single-target defenses

strategies.name: Root Rider + Electro Titan
strategies.army: Root Riders in front with Electro Titans behind to wipe out whatever survives; Clan Castle: a Root Rider or Electro Titan.
strategies.spells: Rage and Freeze for the push, Healing if the defense is spread out.
plan: Clear one side with the Queen to create a straight path.
Root Riders go in first and carve a line through the walls.
Electro Titans follow to clean up everything left near the line.
Rage and Freeze as the group reaches the strongest defenses.

shape.spread: the base is stretched out, and this army steamrolls through the middle

core.weak: it's built for a poorly defended core

strategies.name: Queen Charge LavaLoon
strategies.army: Lava Hounds to tank the Air Defenses, a big wave of Balloons, plus Minions or Headhunters for cleanup.
strategies.spells: Rage and Haste for the Balloons, Freeze for the Infernos and a Poison for the Clan Castle troops.
plan: Queen Charge with Healers takes out an Air Defense and one side of the base.
Lava Hounds go onto the remaining Air Defenses.
Balloons follow in a wide line behind the Hounds.
Rage and Haste as the Balloons reach the core; Freeze Infernos and the Eagle.

core.strong: it's built for bases with a very strong core

inferno.single: Single Infernos struggle against a big Balloon swarm

strategies.name: Hydra (Dragons + Dragon Riders)
strategies.army: Dragons and Dragon Riders together, with an Inferno Dragon or Balloons for support and the Dragon Duke leading.
strategies.spells: Freeze for Infernos and Monolith, Rage for the main group, and Invisibility if the Duke needs it.
plan: Dragon Duke opens one side solo. Keep him enraged and away from Air Sweepers.
Clear both edges of the funnel so the Dragons don't drift around the outside.
Drop Dragons and Dragon Riders as one wide group behind the Duke's path.
Freeze Infernos and Monolith as the group reaches them; Rage in the core.

air.open: there's a clear air path and the Air Sweepers are manageable

shape.spread: Dragons don't need perfect ground pathing on a spread-out base

strategies.name: RC Walk Dragons
strategies.army: Mass Dragons with a couple of Balloons or Rocket Balloons to clear Air Defenses; Clan Castle: Dragon or Balloons.
strategies.spells: Rage, Freeze and Lightning or Zap to take out an Air Defense.
plan: Royal Champion walks one side, clearing defenses for the funnel.
Remove one Air Defense with spells before the Dragons arrive.
Drop Dragons in a wide line behind the Champion's path.
Rage as they reach the core; Freeze Infernos.

scout.new: it's the easiest air army to learn

strategies.name: Throwers + Healers (Warden walk)
strategies.army: Throwers as the damage, with Healers keeping them alive, plus a Log Launcher to break compartments.
strategies.spells: Earthquakes to open compartments, Rage, and Freeze for Infernos.
plan: Earthquake the Clan Castle compartment and nearby walls.
Queen and Dragon Duke make funnels on opposite sides.
Throwers go in behind the funnel with Healers; the Log Launcher opens the way to the core.
Keep the Healers safe from Air Defenses and stop the Throwers drifting outside the funnel.

shape.spread: ground sections can be reached through wall openings

inferno.single: Single Infernos can only lock one Thrower at a time

strategies.name: Dragon Duke + Super Bowlers
strategies.army: Super Bowlers as the core push, with Ice Golems or Yetis as tanks and the Dragon Duke opening the funnel.
strategies.spells: Rage and Freeze for the core push, plus Earthquakes if walls are thick.
plan: The Dragon Duke clears one edge of the funnel.
The Queen or Royal Champion clears the other.
Super Bowlers go in a tight group behind the tanks; their bounce hits rows of buildings.
Rage and Freeze in the core.

core.strong: it's a powerful push for a strong core

shape.compact: bounces shine on compact rows of buildings

strategies.name: Electro Dragons
strategies.army: Mass Electro Dragons, with Balloons to clear Air Defenses.
strategies.spells: Rage, Freeze, and Lightning for an Air Defense.
plan: Check gaps between buildings and the Air Sweeper directions before you start.
Clear one side with heroes.
Drop the Electro Dragons in a line so the chain lightning keeps jumping.
Rage in the core; Freeze Infernos.

shape.compact: buildings are close enough for the lightning to keep jumping

strategies.name: RC Walk Meteor Golems
strategies.army: Meteor Golems as the main push, with Royal Champion support and a few Valkyries or Wall Breakers.
strategies.spells: Rage, Freeze, and Earthquakes for the walls.
plan: The Royal Champion walks one side to set the funnel.
Meteor Golems go in where useful ground targets sit behind several walls.
Practise the split-and-merge timing on the layout before war.
Rage and Freeze in the core.

shape.boxed: useful ground targets sit behind several walls
